citations.assessment: Ilai bar Berekhiah teaches that two scholars on the road should speak words of Torah. This teaching also occurs in Sotah under a variant patronymic.
The digital Sotah has Il’a bar Yevarekhiah and a group of teachings, including one that parallels Ta’anit.
The witness gives Elazar bar Berekhiah in the exposition on a people weary from Torah. Heilprin presents this as a name variant.

holds.reason: The exact attribution through Rabbi Yochanan at the second Sanhedrin locator is unresolved.
